name: Faster inference through clever prediction
gist: These papers speed up how fast a model generates answers by predicting what comes next, reusing previous work, or trying multiple paths in parallel then picking the best one.
explain: Generating text or images is slow because the model has to produce one token — one chunk of text — at a time, and each token requires running through the whole network. If you are generating a 1,000-token response, the network runs 1,000 times. These papers ask: can you predict what comes next before you get there? If you can guess the next few tokens ahead of time, you can cache the computation and then verify it against what the model actually computes, saving work. Or you can try multiple possible next tokens in parallel and pick the best one, which can sometimes shortcut the sequential generation.

One direction is speculative decoding: a small, fast model guesses the next few tokens. The big model then checks whether those guesses are right. If they are, you save the computation of running the big model that many times. If they are wrong, you only spent time on the cheap model's guess. Another angle is dynamic computation: some inputs are easy and need shallow processing, others are hard and need the full depth. Techniques figure out on the fly how much computation each input really needs, skipping layers for easy cases.

A third approach is parallel or tree-based decoding: instead of generating strictly left-to-right, try multiple branches of the generation tree simultaneously and then prune branches that are unlikely. Each of these techniques trades a small overhead in decision-making for large savings in the total number of passes through the network. The papers measure wall-clock time — how long it actually takes to generate an answer — not just model complexity, because overhead that looks cheap mathematically can be slow in real systems.

papers.title: Bridging Draft Policy Misalignment: Group Tree Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: GTO increases acceptance length by 7.4% and yields additional 7.7% speedup over prior state-of-the-art, with proven convergence that increasing Draft Tree Reward improves acceptance length and speedup.

papers.title: FOCUS: DLLMs Know How to Tame Their Compute Bound
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 3.52× throughput improvement over production-grade LMDeploy in large-batch settings while preserving or improving generation quality.

papers.title: FreeKV: Boosting KV Cache Retrieval for Efficient LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves near-lossless accuracy with up to 13x speedup compared to state-of-the-art KV retrieval methods.

papers.title: Learning To Draft: Adaptive Speculative Decoding with Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: LTD achieves speedup ratios of 2.24x to 4.32x across five LLMs and four tasks, outperforming Eagle3 by up to 36.4%.

papers.title: Learning to Parallel: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models via Adaptive Parallel Decoding
papers.contribution: Learn2PD achieves up to 22.58× speedup without performance drop, and up to 57.51× when combined with KV-Cache, without requiring retraining on diverse NLP tasks.

papers.title: MeanCache: From Instantaneous to Average Velocity for Accelerating Flow Matching Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves 4.12x on FLUX.1, 4.56x on Qwen-Image, and 3.59x on HunyuanVideo acceleration while outperforming caching baselines in generation quality.

papers.title: RAEE: A Robust Retrieval-Augmented Early Exit Framework for Efficient Inference
papers.contribution: Enables zero-shot acceleration across eight downstream tasks while enhancing model performance through corrective exit information from intermediate layers.

papers.title: Speculative Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Saguaro is up to 2x faster than speculative decoding and 5x faster than autoregressive decoding.

papers.title: AugServe: Adaptive Request Scheduling for Augmented Large Language Model Inference Serving
papers.contribution: AugServe achieves 6.5x and 4.7x higher effective throughput than vLLM and INFERCEPT on augmented LLM workloads.

papers.title: BWCache: Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers through Block-Wise Caching
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 2.24× speedup with comparable visual quality on several video diffusion models through training-free acceleration.

papers.title: CONCUR: High-Throughput Agentic Batch Inference of LLM via Congestion-Based Concurrency Control
papers.contribution: Prevents middle-phase thrashing and improves batch inference throughput by up to 4.09x on Qwen3-32B and 1.90x on DeepSeek-V3 while remaining compatible with existing LLM serving systems.

papers.title: CSD: Content-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Image Generation
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superiority on Lumina-mGPT and Janus-Pro with dynamic acceptance adjustment increasing rates in low-detail areas while maintaining quality.

papers.title: Cost-Aware Dynamic Tree Construction for Efficient Large Language Model Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves speeds up to 5.2x faster than conventional decoding and outperforms state-of-the-art techniques by 5-20% across six tasks and LLMs.

papers.title: DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves over 6x lossless acceleration across models and tasks; delivers up to 2.5x higher speedup than state-of-the-art speculative decoding method EAGLE-3.

papers.title: DyLLM: Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference via Saliency-based Token Selection and Partial Attention
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 9.6× higher throughput while preserving baseline accuracy across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks.

papers.title: Dynamic Thinking-Token Selection for Efficient Reasoning in Large Reasoning Models
papers.contribution: Surpasses SOTA KV cache compression with 2.6% Pass@1 improvement; reduces inference latency by 1.84-2.62× and peak memory by 3.32-5.73× without compromising reasoning.

papers.title: ECHO: Elastic Speculative Decoding with Sparse Gating for High-Concurrency Scenarios
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 5.35x walltime speedup and over 20% relative improvement against state-of-the-art baselines across model scales including industrial-grade Qwen3-235B.

papers.title: FAFO: Lossy KV Cache Compression for Lossless Inference Acceleration via Draftless Fumble Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.20-2.71x latency speedup while maintaining lossless generation quality without requiring multiple KV cache sets.

papers.title: Fast Byte Latent Transformer
papers.contribution: Achieve estimated memory-bandwidth cost over 50% lower than standard BLT on generation tasks through multiple inference strategies.

papers.title: KnapSpec: Self-Speculative Decoding via Adaptive Layer Selection as a Knapsack Problem
papers.contribution: KnapSpec achieves up to 1.47x wall-clock speedup on Qwen3 and Llama3 without training or output distribution changes, with rigorous theoretical analysis establishing cosine similarity as proxy for token acceptance.

papers.title: LEAP: Zone-Aware MCTS for LLM Self-Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.7x–2.0x speedup for LLM inference.

papers.title: MineDraft: A Framework for Batch Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieve up to 75% throughput improvement and up to 39% latency reduction over standard speculative decoding with vLLM integration.

papers.title: PARD: Accelerating LLM Inference with Low‑Cost PARallel Draft Model Adaptation
papers.contribution: Improves draft training efficiency by 3x and achieves up to 3.67x speedup on LLaMA3.1-8B reaching 264.88 tokens per second.

papers.title: PipeSD: An Efficient Cloud-Edge Collaborative Pipeline Inference Framework with Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: Achieves 1.16-2.16× speedup and reduces energy consumption by 14.3-25.3% across draft-target pairs on real-world cloud-edge testbeds.

papers.title: Predictive Prefetching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 43.5% end-to-end latency reduction and 62.4% improvement in time-to-first-token while maintaining answer quality.

papers.title: ProphetKV: User-Query-Driven Selective Recomputation for Efficient KV Cache Reuse in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: Retains 96-101% of full-prefill accuracy with only 20% recomputation ratio and achieves 8.8-24.9% accuracy improvements on RULER and 18.6-50.9% on LongBench over state-of-the-art approaches.

papers.title: ScaleSim: Serving Large-Scale Multi-Agent Simulation with Invocation Distance-Based Memory Management
papers.contribution: ScaleSim achieves up to 1.74x speedup over SGLang on simulation benchmarks, supporting diverse agent-specific memory through modular interfaces for large-scale multi-agent simulations.

papers.title: SpecBranch: Speculative Decoding via Hybrid Drafting and Rollback-Aware Branch Parallelism
papers.contribution: SpecBranch achieves 1.8x-4.5x speedups over auto-regressive decoding and reduces rollback tokens by 50% on poorly-aligned models while maintaining identical sampling distribution.

papers.title: SpecExit: Accelerating Large Reasoning Model via Speculative Exit
papers.contribution: We achieve up to 66% generation length reduction and 2.5x end-to-end speedup compared to speculative decoding without accuracy loss.

papers.title: SpecForge: A Flexible and Efficient Open-Source Training Framework for Speculative Decoding
papers.contribution: SpecForge achieves up to 9.9x faster EAGLE-3 training and 4.48x end-to-end inference speedup, with production-grade draft models released.

papers.title: Threshold-Based Exclusive Batching for LLM Inference
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 41.9% higher throughput on bandwidth-constrained GPUs via optimized exclusive batching, with EB+ attaining highest throughput under non-stationary traffic.

papers.title: Training-Free Loosely Speculative Decoding: Accepting Semantically Correct Drafts Beyond Exact Match
papers.contribution: Achieves 2.81x speedup on Llama-3.1-70B and 5.07x on 405B while preserving ≥99% accuracy; outperforms training-based EAGLE-3 by 1.62x on out-of-domain data.

papers.title: Variational Speculative Decoding: Rethinking Draft Training from Token Likelihood to Sequence Acceptance
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 9.58% speedup over EAGLE-3 and 8.80% over ViSpec across LLMs and MLLMs.

papers.title: WarmServe: Enabling One-for-Many GPU Prewarming for Multi-LLM Serving
papers.contribution: Reduce tail time-to-first-token by up to 50.8x compared to autoscaling while supporting 2.5x higher throughput than GPU-sharing systems.

papers.title: When Drafts Evolve: Speculative Decoding Meets Online Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 24% speedup over seven benchmarks via principled online learning framework with theoretical dynamic regret justification.
